data.body_html:
Choosing between the Astondoa 40, Azimut 39 and Pershing 46 for your 2042 Marbella charter? You’re looking at three of the most popular motor yachts available from Puerto Banús. Each offers a different balance of capacity, price and style. This three-way comparison breaks down the specs, costs and best use cases so you can book the right boat without guesswork. All three depart from Puerto Banús and include skipper, fuel, drinks and snacks.

Astondoa 40 vs Azimut 39 vs Pershing 46: Specs at a Glance

Capacity and Layout: Who Fits Where?

The Astondoa 40 is certified for 9 guests — ideal for smaller families or couples. The Azimut 39 holds 11, making it the best value for larger groups on a budget. The Pershing 46 takes 10 guests but offers a sportier layout with more deck space. If your party is 10, the Pershing or Azimut work; the Astondoa is too small. For 11, the Azimut is your only option among these three.

Pricing: Tier A vs On Request

Both the Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 fall under Tier A pricing: €749 for 2 hours, €2,299 for a full 8-hour day. That includes everything — skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance and 21% IVA. The Pershing 46 is a premium model; its rate is available on request via WhatsApp. Expect a higher price point for the extra length and performance.

Performance and Experience

The Pershing 46 is the sportiest of the three, designed for faster cruising and a more dynamic ride. The Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 are comfortable cruisers, perfect for leisurely days along the coast. If you want to feel the wind in your hair, go Pershing. If relaxation and socialising are the priority, the Tier A boats deliver.

Best Itineraries for Each Boat

All three are ideal for a 4-hour trip from Puerto Banús to Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés for swimming. For a full day, extend to Estepona or Sotogrande. The Pershing can cover more distance in less time, so you could even reach Gibraltar on an 8-hour charter. The Astondoa and Azimut are better suited to relaxed pacing.

Which Boat Should You Book?

  • Choose the Astondoa 40 if you have 9 guests or fewer and want a cosy, affordable day out.
  • Choose the Azimut 39 if you have up to 11 guests and want the best value per person.
  • Choose the Pershing 46 if you want a larger, faster yacht and are flexible on budget.
